results.primary_cause: Evidence supports a 2026 Capesize freight upswing, but counter-evidence says the apparent strength may be driven by temporary rerouting and could reverse into a 2027 supply glut; durable industry-wide BDI/Capesize/Panamax commodity-volume causality remains conflicting.

supporting_evidence.claim: A key dry-bulk freight-rate measure reached its highest level since December 2023, driven by rising Capesize demand and tightening vessel supply.
supporting_evidence.source_title: Dry-Bulk Shipping Rates Hit Two-Year High on Capesize Demand

supporting_evidence.claim: BIMCO described apparent 2026 dry-bulk strength and linked it to forced rerouting effects.
supporting_evidence.source_title: Dry bulk shipping faces 2027 supply glut: BIMCO warns Hormuz rerouting boost will reverse

counter_evidence.claim: BIMCO warned that the 2026 dry-bulk strength was substantially artificial from forced rerouting and that the boost would reverse, producing a possible 2027 supply glut.
counter_evidence.source_title: Dry bulk shipping faces 2027 supply glut: BIMCO warns Hormuz rerouting boost will reverse

counter_evidence.claim: Dry-bulk earnings are highly sensitive to freight rates, making the apparent cycle vulnerable to rate and valuation reversal.
counter_evidence.source_title: Euroseas Ltd Stock (MHY235261073): valuation in focus after strong bulk shipping cycle

results.primary_cause: International evidence indicates continuing storage demand and AI-related NAND opportunity, but does not establish a synchronized NAND pricing, controller and module cycle; available evidence is insufficient and partly contradictory in scope.

supporting_evidence.claim: A NAND-controller supplier described AI storage and NAND-controller opportunity, indicating evolving storage demand.
supporting_evidence.source_title: Silicon Motion Award Spotlights AI Storage And NAND Controller Potential

counter_evidence.claim: The 2026 Future of Memory and Storage Conference highlighted continued growth in storage and memory, which is broader than and does not independently confirm a NAND cycle.
counter_evidence.source_title: 2026 FMS Shows Storage And Memory Market Continued Growth

counter_evidence.claim: Phison described evolving storage demand and SSD adoption across consumer and data-center applications, without confirming synchronized NAND pricing or module-cycle improvement.
counter_evidence.source_title: Phison Electronics Corp highlights its NAND controller role as demand for storage keeps evolving

counter_evidence.claim: A Phison executive argued that NAND supply cannot respond to demand as it did historically, challenging a simple conventional-cycle interpretation.
counter_evidence.source_title: The Next NAND Decade: Why Supply Can’t Catch Demand The Way It Used To
